items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: They had a colored guy by the name of Peekaboo -- Jimmy Peekaboo Davis. He was a bad guy.

ctx.x: Well, who was trying to break it up?

Well, I guess the musicians downtown such as Duke Ellington, Calloway, Chick Webb, all of them. They didn't want that band to interfere with their progress or interfere with them. Oh, yes, that was a fact. They had a colored guy by the name of Peekaboo -- Jimmy Peekaboo Davis. He was a bad guy.
Well, who did he work for?
